title: Understand
notes: Turn-based board state waits for input; no pause condition is needed. Licensed Windows Steam build 7803420 (1.2.3), official Proton and isolated zero-progress native save. No difficulty selector exists in the tested menu; the original opening is retained. The ending rubric remains uncalibrated and late milestones have not been live-validated. On unchanged upstream 0.7.4, shared understand-pointer-v3 uses native Jev Box targets for click, buttonless movement and drag endpoints. Historical fixed-grid Jev and Codex runs remain pilots, not acceptance of the Box condition. The owner requested a 600-second Jev exception; preserve the standard 3600-second spec and disclose shorter actual runs. New-profile native acceptance and autonomous performance must be reported separately. Current source migration targets official 0.7.6 without shared-core changes. understand-ending-v3 uses the existing endpoint hook for ten group-balanced categories from preserved native history; its scorer needs the pinned licensed game assets and Lua 5.1. Historical v2 rubrics, runtime attribution and published scores remain unchanged.
introduction: Understand is a single-player line puzzle game organized into numbered puzzle groups on a map. A run progresses by completing groups, revealing neighboring groups and eventually reaching the ending puzzle. The run starts at the original opening menu with three empty native save slots, using slot 1. The game has no selected difficulty modifier.
controls: Mouse clicks choose menu entries. A left press starts a path when no path is active; pointer motion extends the active path even after the button is released. The next left press submits that path. A left-button drag presses, moves straight and releases, so it submits an already-active path before moving. Controls include left click, pointer movement without a button and straight left-button drag. Coordinates cover the whole game window.
